jobs.title: Strategic Sourcing Manager - Electronics
jobs.description:
Strategic Sourcing Manager

Purpose of the role

  *  Developing and executing global sourcing strategies for the assigned direct materials categories (electronics)
  *  Acting as a business partner to key stakeholders in Business (Business Units, Engineering, etc.) and Operations (Product Line Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, Production, Materials Management, etc.)
  *  Sustaining the Global Strategic Sourcing Operating Model and providing supply capability and capacity at best cost to support future business needs and protect brand value
  *  Applying aligned sourcing processes, sustainable supplier assessments, and development approaches to establish and actively manage a performing and regulatory-compliant supply base footprint
  *  Contributing to the enhancement of supply base performance on Quality, Delivery, and Cost (QCD)
  *  Realizing measurable value of >3% in recurring and P&L-effective cost reductions per year across the global third-party spend in the assigned categories through leveraged and benchmarked supply base management
  *  Growing and further developing a qualified and performing Best Cost Country (BCC) supply base in line with company and operations objectives, preferably in Eastern Europe, while managing a sustainable spend allocation


Responsibilities:

  *  Management of own material categories (capacity, knowledge management, performance)
  *  Accountable for contributing to global Direct Material & Supply Base Performance (QCD)
  *  Representing own direct material categories within the VAT organization
  *  Accountable for category-specific achievement of objectives related to cost optimization, supply base optimization, geographic sourcing footprint, and Best Cost Country Sourcing
  *  Providing forward-looking guidance on trends, threats, and opportunities within assigned categories (e.g., raw materials)
  *  Actively contributing to the bottom-up alignment of the Direct Materials Category Team with defined company objectives
  *  Acting as the interface to Business Units and Engineering for Strategic Sourcing activities along the PDP (IP07) process
  *  Acting as a change agent toward key stakeholders
  *  Developing category sourcing strategies using defined methods and tools
  *  Managing supplier relationships across the global supply base within assigned category scope, in alignment with category teams in Switzerland, Malaysia, and Romania
  *  Ensuring consistent application of all sourcing levers
  *  Contributing to key sourcing KPIs
  *  Assembling and actively leading category-specific and cross-functional sourcing boards
  *  Actively monitoring and conducting supply base risk assessments across assigned categories
  *  Participating in and contributing to the continuous improvement of direct material sourcing practices


Qualifications:  

  *  3-4 years of in-depth strategic and operational sourcing experience with solid knowledge of global category management
  *  Demonstrated experience with category-specific production techniques and processes
  *  Knowledge of category sourcing markets
  *  Proficiency in Office software and IT applications, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  *  Experience sourcing in Eastern Europe and Asia, including Best Cost Country sourcing and spend relocation activities
  *  Experience working within a global and complex organization
  *  Experience in machine building, vacuum technology, and semiconductors
  *  Experience in cross-functional and category team management (at least functional leadership)
  *  Strong interpersonal, sensitive, and empathetic communication skills with suppliers, colleagues, and internal stakeholders
  *  Strong analytical and risk-based decision-making skills with a focus on key facts
  *  Ability to achieve results through others, manage multiple priorities, set priorities effectively, and handle pressure
  *  Good communication skills in German and English; additional languages are a plus

Description de l'entreprise  
Client:  
Hunter Banker \- Middle East  
Description de l'entreprise  
Client:  
Our client is an established international banking group with a strong Swiss private banking platform, recognised for supporting entrepreneurs, family offices and ultra\-high\-net\-worth individuals with bespoke wealth management and financing solutions. Combining the stability of an international institution with an entrepreneurial and collaborative culture, the bank offers Relationship Managers access to a broad range of capabilities beyond traditional private banking.  
With a long\-term approach to client relationships and a commitment to tailored advice, the bank provides an attractive platform for experienced Private Bankers looking to grow their franchise while delivering sophisticated, cross\-border solutions to international clients.  
Description du poste  
Position:  
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Private Banker to join the Geneva office with responsibility for developing the Middle East market. This is a genuine acquisition role suited to a commercially minded relationship manager with an established network amongst entrepreneurs, family offices and UHNW clients across the GCC and wider region.  
Beyond traditional wealth management, the successful candidate will identify opportunities to deliver broader banking solutions by working closely with internal specialists across corporate finance, structured lending and advisory. This role is ideal for a banker who understands that entrepreneurial clients often require sophisticated financing alongside investment management.  
Key responsibilities:  
Identify opportunities for tailored lending solutions including Lombard facilities, real estate finance and liquidity planning.  
Introduce clients to specialist teams for corporate finance, succession planning and strategic advisory where appropriate.  
Develop relationships with entrepreneurs and family\-owned businesses, recognising both their private wealth and commercial banking needs.  
Partner with internal experts to deliver integrated banking solutions across investments, financing and wealth planning.  
This opportunity offers the chance to join a forward\-thinking private bank where relationship managers have access to a broad range of capabilities extending well beyond traditional investment management. You'll work in a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, direct access to decision\-makers and the ability to deliver tailored solutions across wealth management, financing and corporate advisory, creating lasting value for clients and sustainable business growth.  
Profil recherché  
Profile:  
Minimum 10 years' experience as a Private Banker or Relationship Manager covering the Middle East market.  
Proven track record of acquiring and developing UHNW clients, entrepreneurs and family office relationships.  
Established network across the GCC, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Turkey or the wider Middle East.  
Strong understanding of Swiss private banking together with experience advising entrepreneurial clients on financing and broader commercial banking opportunities.  
Ability to recognise and originate opportunities relating to lending, corporate finance, structured credit or business succession alongside traditional wealth management.  
Commercially driven with exceptional relationship management, business development and networking skills.  
Collaborative mindset with the ability to work alongside specialists across investments, lending and advisory disciplines.  
Strong understanding of Swiss regulatory standards, compliance and risk management.  
Professional qualifications such as CFA, CAIA, SAQ Wealth Management or equivalent would be advantageous.  
Eligible to work in Switzerland.

Sie profitieren von attraktivem Wohnen und niedrigeren Kosten als in Basel.

### Ihre Aufgaben als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Stv. Stationsleitung in Frick

jobs.description:
Description de l'entreprise  
A l'Hospice général,  
Chef de Service Sécurité Humaine \& Incendie H/F, 80\-100%, CDI \- Direction Immobilier  
Description de l'entreprise  
A l'Hospice général, nous œuvrons pour le mieux vivre ensemble à Genève  
Fondée en 1535 à Genève, notre institution accompagne les personnes qui, à un moment de leur vie, ont besoin d'un soutien le temps nécessaire pour (re)trouver une autonomie durable. Nous favorisons la réinsertion sociale et professionnelle des personnes à l'aide sociale, nous accueillons et hébergeons les personnes issues de l'asile que nous suivons dans leur parcours d'intégration. Enfin, nous participons à la lutte contre l'isolement des seniors.  
Nous sommes plus de 1' 600 collaboratrices et collaborateurs répartis sur 60 sites sur tout le territoire du canton. Nous accompagnons plus de 40' 000 personnes.  
En rejoignant notre institution, vous participerez à la réalisation de notre mission sociale, ancrée dans nos valeurs de collaboration, de respect, d'engagement et de bienveillance.  
Dans un contexte où nos équipes évoluent dans des domaines exigeants et en mutation constante, nous mettons un point d'honneur à leur proposer des conditions de travail stimulantes : nous visons la diversité et l'inclusion, nous valorisons l'intelligence collective, incitons aux échanges et à l'innovation et favorisons la prise d'initiative et l'expérimentation.  
Description du poste  
Votre mission  
La Direction Immobilier pilote la stratégie d'hébergement des bénéficiaires et le déploiement des locaux administratifs de l'institution. Elle optimise la gestion de son parc immobilier et assure également, sur mandat, la gestion du patrimoine de plusieurs fondations privées.  
Rattaché\-e à la Direction Immobilier, vous êtes chargé\-e de construire la gouvernance institutionnelle de la sécurité humaine et incendie de l'Hospice général. À ce titre, vous définissez le cadre stratégique, les règles de gouvernance et les modes de fonctionnement permettant d'assurer une gestion cohérente, efficiente et durable de la sécurité sur l'ensemble des sites de l'institution, en étroite collaboration avec la Direction générale et les directions concernées.  
Garant\-e de la sécurité des personnes et des biens, vous veillez à offrir un environnement sûr et sécurisé aux collaboratrices et collaborateurs, aux bénéficiaires ainsi qu'aux partenaires de l'institution, tout en assurant la protection du patrimoine immobilier de l'Hospice général.  
Dans un contexte de transformation organisationnelle, vous pilotez la structuration de la fonction sécurité et accompagnez l'évolution des équipes, des pratiques et de la culture institutionnelle. Vous développez une approche fondée sur la prévention, l'anticipation des risques et l'amélioration continue, afin de renforcer durablement la maîtrise des risques et l'efficience des ressources humaines, organisationnelles et financières.  
Véritable partenaire de la Direction Immobilier, vous fédérez les directions, les équipes opérationnelles, les autorités et les partenaires externes autour d'une vision commune de la sécurité, au service de la mission sociale de l'Hospice général.  
Vos activités principales  
Gouvernance et stratégie sécurité  
Vous construisez et mettez en place la gouvernance institutionnelle de la sécurité humaine et incendie en définissant les rôles, responsabilités, les processus décisionnels et les instances de pilotage ;  
Vous élaborez la stratégie institutionnelle de sécurité ainsi que la feuille de route permettant son déploiement progressif ;  
Vous définissez les référentiels, standards, procédures et plans d'action garantissant une approche harmonisée sur l'ensemble des sites ;  
Vous développez les outils de pilotage, les tableaux de bord et les indicateurs de performance afin de mesurer l'efficacité du dispositif et de soutenir la prise de décision ;  
Vous assurez une veille réglementaire permanente et garantissez la conformité des dispositifs aux prescriptions cantonales et aux normes en vigueur ;  
Vous élaborez, pilotez et suivez le budget du service sécurité, en veillant à une utilisation efficiente des ressources et à l'atteinte des objectifs fixés ;  
Vous identifiez les priorités d'investissement, proposez les arbitrages nécessaires et assurez le suivi financier des projets et des prestations liés à la sécurité.  
Management et coordination  
Vous assurez le management d'une équipe d'environ quinze collaboratrices et collaborateurs spécialisés dans les domaines de la sécurité humaine et incendie ;  
Vous accompagnez le développement des compétences, favorisez l'engagement des équipes et instaurez une culture de responsabilité, de prévention et de performance ;  
Vous mobilisez et accompagnez les équipes afin de développer une culture commune de la sécurité et de renforcer la transversalité entre les différents sites ;  
Vous développez des relations de confiance avec les directions, les responsables de site, les collaboratrices et collaborateurs de l'institution, ainsi qu'avec les autorités cantonales, les services de secours et les partenaires institutionnels ;  
Vous pilotez les contrats et les prestations liés à la sécurité humaine et incendie, veillez à la qualité des prestations fournies et assurez une gestion efficiente des partenaires externes.  
Transformation, prévention et amélioration continue  
Vous développez une approche de la sécurité fondée sur l'anticipation des risques, la protection des personnes et l'amélioration continue ;  
Vous identifiez les leviers d'amélioration et conduisez les projets permettant d'optimiser les ressources humaines, organisationnelles et financières ;  
Vous contribuez à faire de la sécurité un levier de confiance, de qualité de service et de performance au bénéfice des collaborateurs, des bénéficiaires et des partenaires de l'institution.  
Pilotage opérationnel  
Vous supervisez la gestion des incidents majeurs, coordonnez les retours d'expérience et assurez le suivi des actions correctives ;  
Vous réalisez des audits réguliers afin d'évaluer la performance du dispositif et d'identifier les axes d'amélioration ;  
Vous assurez un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction Immobilier et de la Direction générale sur la performance du dispositif, les risques et les actions d'amélioration ;  
Vous accompagnez les projets immobiliers et institutionnels afin d'intégrer les exigences de sécurité dès leur conception et tout au long de leur réalisation.  
Qualifications  
Votre profil  
Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation universitaire en sécurité ou d'un diplôme d'ingénieur HES/EPF, complété par un brevet fédéral AEAI de spécialiste en protection incendie, ou vous disposez d'une expérience et de formations vous ayant permis d'atteindre un niveau d'expertise équivalent ;  
Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience confirmée d'au moins cinq ans dans une fonction de management de la sécurité au sein d'organisations multisites complexes ;  
Vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie du management d'équipes ;  
Vous disposez de solides compétences en gouvernance, conduite du changement, gestion de projets et amélioration continue ;  
Vous êtes reconnu\-e pour votre capacité à construire une vision stratégique, fédérer des équipes et accompagner des transformations dans des environnements complexes ;  
Vous possédez une excellente compréhension des enjeux réglementaires, organisationnels et humains liés à la sécurité ;  
À l'aise dans un environnement exigeant et en constante évolution, vous faites preuve d'organisation, de discernement, d'autonomie et d'une forte capacité à prioriser ;  
Vous êtes reconnu\-e pour vos excellentes qualités relationnelles, rédactionnelles et votre capacité à adapter votre communication à des interlocuteurs variés ;  
Vous maîtrisez les outils numériques, les tableaux de bord et les indicateurs de pilotage nécessaires à une gestion performante de la fonction ;  
Doté\-e d'un leadership participatif, vous savez mobiliser les équipes autour d'une vision commune, développer une culture institutionnelle de la prévention et conduire le changement avec pragmatisme et conviction ;  
Orienté\-e solutions et résultats, vous savez concilier maîtrise des risques, qualité de service, efficience organisationnelle et optimisation des ressources humaines et financières ;  
Vous disposez d'une expérience confirmée en élaboration, pilotage et suivi budgétaire et savez concilier maîtrise financière, qualité de service et performance opérationnelle.  
Informations supplémentaires  
Nous vous proposons  
Une culture d'entreprise ouverte et respectueuse ;  
Un développement continu des compétences grâce à une politique de formation attractive ;  
Des opportunités d'évolution de carrière et de mobilité interne ;  
De vraies solutions pour favoriser un équilibre vie professionnelle\-vie privée ;  
De nombreuses activités culturelles et sportives à vivre en collectif au sein de l'institution.  
Taux d'activité : 80\-100%  
Type de contrat : CDI  
Classe de fonction : 23  
Lieu de travail : Route des Acacias 54 bis  
Entrée en fonction : Dès que possible  
Délai de postulation :  
Notre processus de recrutement  
Il se déroule en plusieurs phases selon le type de poste, où chaque étape conditionne la suivante : analyse de candidature, entretien téléphonique, entretiens de recrutement avec la hiérarchie et les ressources humaines et le cas échéant, test métier et/ou évaluation type assessement pour les postes de management et certains postes spécifiques.  
Ce poste vous intéresse ?  
Le service de recrutement de l'Hospice général se réjouit de recevoir votre candidature complète (lettre de motivation, CV, diplôme de plus haut niveau de formation atteint, certificats de travail). Pour des raisons d'optimisation du suivi des candidatures, nous vous invitons à postuler uniquement en ligne, en réponse à une offre d'emploi spécifique. jpid498be48jm jpit0731jm jpiy26jm

jobs.description:
About Infinity Motion Services:

Infinity Motion Services (IMS) is a Swiss high-performance figure skating organisation dedicated to developing athletes through a comprehensive and scientifically based coaching methodology.
Our mission is to provide long-term athlete development by combining technical excellence, evidence-based coaching, physical preparation and international competitive exposure. We work with competitive skaters of different ages and levels, supporting their progression from foundational skills to national and international competition.
To support the continued expansion of our activities, we are seeking an exceptionally experienced Senior Figure Skating Technical Director & High Performance Coach who will lead the technical direction of our skating programmes and contribute to the long-term development of our athletes and coaching philosophy.

Position Summary:

The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing and supervising the technical development pathway of competitive figure skaters while ensuring the highest coaching standards throughout all stages of athlete development.
This position combines high-level technical coaching, programme development, coach mentoring and athlete support during domestic and international competitions.
The role requires an individual capable of integrating modern sports science with proven figure skating coaching methodologies to maximise athlete performance over the long term.

Key Responsibilities:

•    Design and implement long-term technical development programmes for competitive figure skaters.
•    Deliver elite-level coaching in skating skills, edge quality, jump technique, spin development and overall technical progression.
•    Develop individual annual and multi-year athlete development plans.
•    Design structured technical progression systems tailored to athletes of different ages and competitive levels.
•    Monitor athlete progress through continuous technical evaluation and performance analysis.
•    Integrate on-ice technical development with off-ice conditioning programmes, including strength, flexibility, coordination, rotational training and injury prevention.
•    Collaborate with choreographers, off-ice trainers, physiotherapists, sports scientists and other specialists to ensure holistic athlete development.
•    Mentor and support junior coaches through technical education and knowledge transfer.
•    Develop coaching guidelines and technical documentation supporting organisational coaching standards.
•    Organise and conduct international figure skating camps and technical seminars.
•    Participate in talent identification and athlete selection.
•    Support parents through regular communication regarding athlete development plans.
•    Maintain the highest safeguarding, ethical and professional coaching standards.
•    Accompany athletes throughout the competitive season, including domestic and international competitions, training camps and development programmes, ensuring continuous technical supervision before, during and after performances. Responsibilities include competition planning, technical briefings, rink-side coaching, performance evaluation, coordination with event organisers and continuous communication with athletes and their families to support long-term athletic development.

Required Qualifications:

The successful candidate must demonstrate all of the following qualifications:
•    Master's Degree (or equivalent higher education qualification) in Sport Sciences, Physical Education or a closely related discipline.
•    Minimum 20 years of professional coaching experience in competitive figure skating.
•    Demonstrated experience coaching athletes from beginner level through advanced competitive levels.
•    Proven experience designing long-term athlete development programmes.
•    Extensive knowledge of skating skills, edge quality, jump mechanics, spin development and competition preparation.
•    Strong understanding of biomechanics and evidence-based coaching methodologies.
•    Demonstrated ability to integrate sports science principles into daily coaching activities.
•    Experience coordinating both on-ice and off-ice athlete development.
•    Experience organising and leading international figure skating camps.
•    Experience working with athletes across multiple age categories.
•    Strong communication skills with athletes, parents and multidisciplinary coaching teams.
•    Excellent organisational and planning abilities.
•    Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within an international coaching environment.
•    Fluency in English (written and spoken).

Preferred Qualifications:

Candidates possessing one or more of the following qualifications will be considered particularly suitable:
•    Experience working with athletes who have achieved success at national or international level.
•    Previous collaboration with Olympic-level or World Championship coaching teams.
•    Proven experience within internationally recognised Russian figure skating technical schools or coaching systems is considered a strong asset.
•    Strong understanding of the methodologies traditionally associated with the Russian school of figure skating, particularly in technical skill development, jump progression and long-term athlete development.
•    Experience mentoring elite coaches.
•    Advanced knowledge of off-ice conditioning specifically developed for figure skating athletes.
•    Experience designing integrated technical development pathways for competitive clubs and high-performance programmes.
•    International coaching experience across Europe.
•    Ability to develop evidence-based coaching systems that can be transferred across different athlete profiles.
•    Knowledge of athlete monitoring methodologies and performance evaluation systems.

International Competition & Travel Requirements:

The successful candidate must be willing and able to work in Switzerland while maintaining a highly flexible international travel schedule.
The role requires frequent travel throughout Europe and, when necessary, internationally to accompany athletes during competitions, training camps, technical seminars and other high-performance events.
Availability to travel on weekends, public holidays and during school holiday periods is essential, as athletes regularly compete and participate in training camps outside standard working days.
The successful candidate will be expected to provide on-site technical coaching throughout the entire duration of competitions and training camps, including official practice sessions, warm-ups, competition preparation, rink-side coaching during performances, post-performance technical analysis and athlete supervision.
Candidates should also demonstrate proven experience accompanying athletes to national and international competitions while coordinating effectively with event organisers, technical officials, coaching teams and athletes' families.

Personal Profile:

We are looking for an individual who demonstrates:
•    Outstanding technical expertise.
•    Exceptional attention to detail.
•    Passion for athlete development.
•    Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities.
•    Calm and confident decision-making under competitive pressure.
•    Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
•    Ability to motivate athletes while maintaining high technical standards.
•    High ethical standards and professional integrity.
•    Commitment to continuous professional development.
•    Strong organisational and planning capabilities.
•    Collaborative mindset within multidisciplinary coaching environments.

What We Offer:

•    Permanent employment within an ambitious Swiss high-performance figure skating organisation.
•    Opportunity to shape the long-term technical direction of a growing international programme.
•    International coaching environment.
•    Professional autonomy.
•    Competitive salary package commensurate with qualifications and experience.
•    Continuous professional development opportunities.
•    Opportunity to contribute to the development of athletes competing nationally and internationally.

Application Process:

Applicants should submit:
•    Detailed Curriculum Vitae.
•    Copies of academic qualifications.
•    Summary of coaching achievements.
•    Relevant coaching certifications.
•    Professional references.

Only candidates whose qualifications and professional experience closely match the requirements outlined above will be contacted for the next stage of the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Human Factors Engineer
jobs.description:
Human Factors Engineer
----------------------

Roche Schweiz bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are located here. For our longstanding client, Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz, we are looking for a

**Human Factors Engineer**
==========================

**Background:**

Roche Diagnostics Global Customer Experience and Solution Design Team (CXSD team) is looking for a passionate Senior Human Factors Engineer to redefine Roche User Interface and Product design and transform the Healthcare industry for the better. At CXSD you will join an international group of designers that serve our purpose to bring the voice of customers to the core of Roche Diagnostics decisions by designing and enabling a seamless patient-centric experience across our portfolio of products and services. You'll be part of building design maturity for Roche with peers who are passionate, energetic, and caring in a connected, multicultural, highly motivated team.

As a Human Factors Engineer, you will play a key role in the development of the next generation of medical devices that can diagnose critical diseases. You will be responsible for leading and documenting studies aimed at providing insights for the development team to improve the design as well as to provide objective evidence that the design outputs of a certain phase in the product development life-cycle are meeting all requirements.

**The Perfect Candidate** has more than 5 years of experience in applied Human Factor Engineering and in Design Control Management. Additionally, the person is experienced in the Usability Engineering process for medical devices made of both hardware and software, as well as in planning, executing, and documenting usability studies in the medical field. Also, the person is knowledgeable of the IEC 62366 standard and the latest FDA guidance on applying human factors engineering. Lastly, the candidate communicates fluently in English.

**Tasks \& Responsibilities:**

* Be the voice of patients and Roche users in every product-related discussion
* Identify user profiles, tasks, hazard-related use scenarios, usability risks, and requirements
* Responsible for translating UX research insights, user needs, business requirements, and technical requirements into pleasant and efficient User Experiences
* Responsible for creating medical device usability deliverables according to IEC 62366
* Create and facilitate workshops with the product teams to gather system-level information and to coordinate the design deliverables
* Plan formative and summative usability studies and coordinate external suppliers in the process
* Prepare, maintain, and review Usability Engineering Files
* Advocate for accessibility, quality, and usability for end-users at Roche Diagnostics
* Provide guidance and mentorship to more junior designers supporting them on professional development, output, and productivity

**Must Haves:**

* Master's degree in Science, Industrial Engineering, Human Factors Engineering, or other related technical field
* Min. 5 years experience in applied Human Factor Engineering and in Design Control Management
* Experience in the Usability Engineering process for medical devices made of both hardware and software
* Experienced in planning, executing, and documenting usability studies in the medical field

jobs.title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Tagdienst 50-100% für die Region Steffisburg gesucht
jobs.description:
- Ein etabliertes Pflegeheim in der Region Steffisburg sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, geregelter Tagdienst mit planbaren Arbeitszeiten.

### Auf einen Blick: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für die Region Steffisburg

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Tagdienst im Pflegeheim

**Pensum:** 50–100 % (flexibel wählbar)

**Anstellungsart:** Festanstellung

**Einsatzbeginn:** Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Steffisburg

**Arbeitgeber:** Pflegeheim – den Namen erfahren Sie im Gespräch

Steffisburg liegt im Emmental und bietet Ihnen eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung durch die Bahnlinie Bern-Luzern. Die Region besticht durch ihre idyllische Lage inmitten von Natur und Landwirtschaft, während Sie gleichzeitig schnell in die Städte Bern und Luzern gelangen. Als Arbeitsort überzeugt Steffisburg durch seine Mischung aus ländlichem Charme und wirtschaftlicher Dynamik sowie günstigere Lebenshaltungskosten im Vergleich zu größeren Zentren.

### Diese Tätigkeiten erwarten Sie in Steffisburg

- Verantwortung für den gesamten Pflegeprozess von der Bedarfserhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Vorbereitung und Abgabe der Medikamente
- Überwachung von Vitalzeichen und frühzeitiges Erkennen von Zustandsveränderungen
- Fachliche Anleitung von FaGe, Pflegeassistenz und Lernenden im Team
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen Pflegesystem
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien und Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe
- Darüber hinaus Mitgestaltung von Pflegekonzepten sowie wir verbessern die Qualität stetig im Team
- Teilnahme an interprofessionellen Rapporten und Visiten im geregelten Tagdienst

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Empathie und Belastbarkeit
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. Niveau B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Tagdienst im Pflegeheim

Diese Stelle ist im Tagdienst angelegt. Sie arbeiten also in einer klaren Tagesstruktur mit geregelten Übergaben am Morgen und am Abend. Dabei nehmen Sie an Rapporten im Team mit Ärzten und Therapien teil, koordinieren Termine mit Ärzten und Therapeuten und begleiten Angehörigengespräche. Somit verbinden Sie fachliche Verantwortung mit einem planbaren Alltag.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau oder Pflegefachmann HF/FH im Tagdienst verbinden Sie fachliche Tiefe mit einem Alltag, der Planung zulässt. Genau deshalb ist die Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH im Tagdienst in Steffisburg bei Berufsleuten mit Familie so beliebt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben zum Beispiel den Pflegebedarf, planen anschliessend die Massnahmen, führen sie durch und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern sie die Medikamentenabgabe, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen im Gesundheitszustand frühzeitig. So entsteht Pflegequalität, die bei jeder Bewohnerin und jedem Bewohner ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die dreijährige höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium in Pflege an einer Fachhochschule (FH). Beide Abschlüsse berechtigen zur eigenverantwortlichen Berufsausübung. Ausländische Diplome benötigen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen attraktive Weiterbildungen offen, etwa ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Funktion als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH in der Region Steffisburg ist äußerst dynamisch und bietet Ihnen hervorragende Chancen. Aufgrund des chronischen Fachkräftemangels im Gesundheitswesen besteht eine konstant hohe Nachfrage nach qualifiziertem Pflegepersonal, insbesondere für flexible Tagdienste im 50-100%-Umfang. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Personalvermittler durch gezielte Kontakte zu etablierten Arbeitgebern in der Region, persönliche Beratung und eine unkomplizierte Vermittlung, die Ihren Einstieg in eine neue Position erheblich beschleunigt.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Steffisburg

- Gratis-Weiterbildungen dank [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – Ihre Karriere bekommt Rückenwind
- Dazu persönliche Beratung durch Ihre feste Ansprechperson, von der Bewerbung bis zum Stellenantritt
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Ebenso faire, GAV-konforme Anstellungsbedingungen mit transparentem Lohn
- Langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Vor allem aber gilt: absolute Diskretion – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH im Tagdienst in Steffisburg

**Welche Ausbildung benötige ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit einer SRK-Anerkennung ebenfalls willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Arbeite ich in dieser Stelle auch nachts?**
Nein, denn diese Stelle ist bewusst im Tagdienst angelegt. Sie profitieren daher von planbaren Arbeitszeiten mit geregelten Übergaben.

**Kann ich das Pensum frei wählen?**
Ja, denn das Pensum ist zwischen 50 und 100 Prozent flexibel wählbar. Sagen Sie uns einfach, welches Modell zu Ihrem Leben passt.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Sie erhalten in der Regel innert 24 Stunden eine Antwort – denn Warten ist verlorene Zeit. Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir dabei streng vertraulich.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, natürlich: Im persönlichen Gespräch erfahren Sie sofort, um welche Institution es geht. Im Inserat verzichten wir jedoch aus Diskretionsgründen darauf.

Gut zu wissen: Viele weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie auf med-ipersonal.ch – täglich aktualisiert.

jobs.title: Product Life Cycle Manager (m/f/d) (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition.You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

The Product Life Cycle Manager (m/f/d) acts as central coordinator for all Service life cycle activities. You drive continuous portfolio optimization based on customer needs, business strategy, and operational excellence. You are responsible for the successful execution and monitoring of the product life cycle management system and the associated processes.

**Your responsibilities:**
- Take ownership for execution of following key processes along the product life cycle phases with corresponding analysis:
- ​Service Readiness Process (Support the ramp-up and integration of newly developed turbochargers into the Service portfolio).
- Portfolio Transfer from New Business to Service Business (Holistic service responsibility across all material levels like raw-/semi-finished & finished products).
- Legacy & Phase-Out Process (Manage the reduction of demand and activities leading to the discontinuation of service availability).
- Ensure continuous improvement of LCM processes and governance, develop KPIs and dashboards for portfolio performance & drive automation of life cycle management activities
- Coordinate cross-functional teams to execute life cycle initiatives, facilitate governance meetings and decision-making processes
- Proactively drive communication of product life cycle information (e.g. product launch, discontinuation) towards all internal & external stakeholders
- Contribute to the Service business strategy by acceleration, coordination and realization of new product-specific initiatives (e.g. global NPP spare part set-up, reactivation of phased out TCs)
- Ensure that the master data in the BU portfolio, SAP and other related systems is up to date and reflects the latest LCM decisions
- Represent Service Business in cross-divisional portfolio alignments (e.g. PMS, product portfolio reviews)

**Your background:**
- 5 years of experience in Product Life Cycle or Portfolio Management, Strategic planning, After Sales, Service Engineering in the role of Portfolio or Life Cylce Manager (or similar) within mechanical engineering industry
- Sound knowledge of manufacturing processes, service operations, and industrial supply chains within the aftermarket business
- Experience in managing complex product portfolios and installed equipment
- Proven experience leading cross-functional projects and managing stakeholders on different hierarchy levels
- Proactive, self-driven, and accountable - you identify opportunities, take ownership, and deliver measurable improvements
- Advanced knowledge in SAP ECC MDM & MM (S/4 HANA is a plus), Microsoft Office 365 and PowerBI required
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Engineering
- Fluent in English & German

**Your benefits:**
- Canteen
- Childcare
- Modern office, smart working
- Flexible Working Model
- Attractive holiday plans
- Employee Assistance Program

Rieter is the world’s leading system supplier for processing natural and man\-made fibers into short\-staple and long\-staple yarn, as well as for the production of filament yarns, man\-made fibers and nonwovens. With its comprehensive technology portfolio, Rieter covers the entire textile value chain – from fiber to yarn, and from polymer melt to texturized filament, synthetic staple fibers and nonwoven. Headquartered in Winterthur, Switzerland, the company designs and engineers complex spinning plants, machines, systems, and components that enable an efficient and economical production. jobs.title: Medewerker Wegeniswerken
jobs.description:
Als medewerker infra wegenis werk je samen met je ploeg aan diverse wegenisprojecten in Vlaanderen

Wat behoort er tot jouw takenpakket?

  • In teamverband voer je accuraat en binnen de vooropgestelde timing de wegeniswerken uit;
  • Handmatig help je de ploeg bij het uitvoeren van de verschillende werken: huisaansluitingen, opritten maken of herstellen, bedding voor wegenis, borduren maken, klinkers leggen, rioleringswerken, kolken aansluiten, bedienen van kleine machines,..
  • Je vormt een ploeg van 2 (of 3) en volgt de instructies van de werfleiding.
  • Brede kennis en ervaring in wegenis- en rioleringswerken.
  • Rijbewijs B om je te verplaatsen naar onze werven of tot aan een oppikpunt.
  • Veilig en ordelijk werken zijn eigenschappen die jou beschrijven, net zoals flexibel en gedreven te werk gaan;
  • Een VCA attest heb je al op zak of ben je bereidt te behalen;
  • Je kan jouw vlot uitdrukken in het Nederlands, Frans of Engels;
  • Ervaring met een minigraver is een pluspunt

jobs.title: Fleet Sales Advisor - regio Limburg
jobs.description:
Fleet Sales Advisor - A&M Hasselt

Wat ga je doen als Fleet Sales Advisor bij A&M?

  • Binnen onze merkengroep BMW/MINI zijn wij op zoek naar een gedreven en gemotiveerde Fleet advisor voor Regio Limburg.
  • Als Fleet advisor ben je het aanspreekpunt van de bestaande B2B-klanten en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de opvolging van al hun vragen omtrent mobiliteitsoplossingen (verkoop, naverkoop, verhuur,…).
  • Daarnaast prospecteer je actief bedrijven in de regio om de bestaande B2B-portfeuille uit te breiden. Je stelt ons uitgebreid gamma aan wagens en totaalpakket aan dienstverlening voor.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met de Sales Managers en collega Fleet Advisors binnen onze groep.
  • Door actief te netwerken op events en je te profileren als ambassadeur van onze BMW-groep zorg je voor de lokale verankering van het merk.
  • Je initieert en implementeert acties om de klantbeleving en B2B resultaten te optimaliseren en continu te verbeteren. Je volgt deze acties op en stuurt bij waar nodig.

Waarmee kan je het team versterken?

  • Naast een passie voor klantgerichtheid, wagens en innovatie ben je een actieve netwerker met ervaring in een B2B-omgeving. Ervaring binnen de automotive is een must.
  • Jij bent de kandidaat die elke dag naar een “Best in Class” resultaat streeft en de filosofie van onze groep: “Gedreven door passie” uitdraagt.
  • Door jouw commercieel talent benut je elke opportuniteit om de verdere groei van ons B2B-segment te garanderen. Door je dagelijks streven naar uiterste klantentevredenheid slaag je erin lange termijn relaties uit te bouwen.
  • Je maakt een sterke eerste indruk naar elke klant en medewerker en straalt vertrouwen uit.
  • Je bent analytisch sterk, je heb snel inzicht in een wagenpark en kan vervolgens een plan op maat ontwikkelen in functie van de klantbehoeften.
  • Je bent bij voorkeur drietalig. Nederlands en Engels is een must, Frans is een sterk pluspunt.
  • Jouw uitvalsbasis is Hasselt, maar je bent ook vaak op locatie.

Lijkt dit iets voor jou?

  • Stel je kandidaat via de knop " Solliciteren".
  • Meer info nodig? BMW JOY’N US, 03/890.58.42

jobs.title: Elektromechanisch onderhoudstechnieker
jobs.description:
Als onderhoudsmedewerker sta je in voor mechanische (70%) en elektrische (30%) herstellingen en onderhoud van het interne machinepark, liftsystemen, rolbruggen en gereedschappen.

Met een passie voor sleutelen en onderhoud, verzorg je in team het onderhoud van machinepark, gebouwen en gereedschap. Je neemt initiatief en kan zelfstandig projecten of opdrachten uitwerken. Mechanisch ben je sterk (het zijn voornamelijk mechanische interventies), je hebt ook wat kennis van residentiële en industriële elektriciteit.

Je bent niet bang om je handen vuil te maken en je bent flexibel inzetbaar. Je kan efficiënt, proper en nauwkeurig werken. Je bent een echte teamplayer.

Bij voorkeur behaalde je een professionele bachelor in (auto)mechanica, elektromechanica, elektriciteit.

jobs.title: Installateur/monteur nichewerk tot €4200
jobs.description:
Werk je graag in openlucht, hou je van fysiek werk en wil je meebouwen aan infrastructuur waar dagelijks duizenden mensen op rekenen? Als spoorwerker maak je deel uit van een team dat instaat voor de aanleg, vernieuwing en het onderhoud van tram- en treinsporen. Je werkt mee aan grote projecten waar je achteraf met trots op kan terugkijken.

  • Je voert allerlei bouwwerken uit: grondwerken, kabelwerken en aanleg nieuwe infrastructuur volgens plannen en instructies.
  • Je werkt met verschillende machines en gereedschappen zoals minigravers, boormachines, slijptoestellen en handgereedschap.
  • Je volgt veiligheids-, kwaliteits- en milieuregels strikt op.
  • Je gebruikt machines en materiaal correct en volgens de geldende procedures.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met je ploeg en volgt de richtlijnen van de ploegbaas of projectleider.
  • Je werkt graag buiten en bent flexibel ingesteld voor verplaatsingen naar werven.
  • Je hebt geen probleem met nacht- en weekendwerk, zodat alle bedrijvigheid tijdens weekdagen niet verstoord wordt.
  • Je hebt al een eerste ervaring in de bouwsector óf je bent net afgestudeerd in een bouwgerichte opleiding.
  • Je bent gemotiveerd, leergierig en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen.
  • Je wil een vak leren binnen een gespecialiseerde niche.

jobs.title: Medewerker Signalisatie
jobs.description:
Samen met de collega’s van de afdeling infra-signalisatie sta je in voor het voorzien van signalisatie op de openbare weg en in werkzones. Zo informeer en begeleid je weggebruikers op een veilige manier.

Wat behoort tot jouw takenpakket?

  • Je ondersteunt de signalisatieploeg met een botsabsorbeerder en waakt over de veiligheid van je team.

  • Je helpt bij het plaatsen van wegsignalisatie op openbare wegen en privéterreinen.

  • Je staat mee in voor het opstarten, opvolgen en opruimen van de werven.

  • Je vertrekt vanuit ons depot te Zedelgem of Grobbendonk.

  • Je springt bij waar nodig en ondersteunt ook andere departementen indien nodig.

  • Volgende eigenschappen beshrijven jou: gemotiveerd, een teamplayer en zin om te werken.

  • Een rijbewijs C is noodzakelijk (pluspunt: rijbewijs CE).

  • Je werkt georganiseerd en respecteert de veiligheidsregels.

  • Flexibiliteit is voor jou geen probleem, want je werkt onder een permantieregeling en een nachtregime.

jobs.title: Wegenwerker
jobs.description:
• Het aanleggen, renoveren en onderhouden van wegen, fietspaden en andere infrastructuur.
  • Het aanbrengen van asfalt, klinkers, bestrating en andere materialen.
  • Het uitvoeren van graaf- en grondwerkzaamheden, bijvoorbeeld voor de aanleg van funderingen, rioleringen en kabels.
  • Het verhelpen van schade aan verhardingen, zoals het vervangen van beschadigde bestrating en het herstellen van asfaltwegen.
  • Het voorbereiden en opruimen van de werkplek, zorgen voor een veilige werkomgeving.
  • Het bedienen van machines zoals asfaltwalsen, graafmachines en trilstampers.
  • Het uitvoeren van kwaliteitscontroles en het naleven van de veiligheids- en milieuvoorschriften.
  • Het uitvoeren van kleine onderhoudswerkzaamheden aan gereedschappen en machines.
  • Ervaring in de wegenbouw of een vergelijkbare functie is een pré.
  • In bezit van een geldig VCA-certificaat (of bereid deze te behalen).
  • Ervaring met het bedienen van machines zoals minigravers, trilstampers of asfaltwalsen is een pluspunt.
  • Een goed fysiek uithoudingsvermogen, aangezien het werk fysiek belastend kan zijn.
  • Bereidheid om in verschillende weersomstandigheden en op verschillende locaties te werken.
  • Flexibel en een echte teamspeler, maar ook in staat om zelfstandig taken uit te voeren.
  • Veiligheidsbewust en verantwoordelijk in het uitvoeren van werkzaamheden.
  • Rijbewijs B (bij voorkeur ook BE) is een pré.

jobs.title: Handarbeiders wegeniswerken
jobs.description:
Voor een familiebedrijf  gespecialiseerd in wegenbouw zijn we op zoek zijn naar handarbeiders wegeniswerken. 

  • Je bent de handlanger van de kraanmachinist en ondersteunt hem naast de kraan.
  • Je plaatst de buizen in de sleuf.
  • Je helpt mee met de aanleg van straten en fietspaden.
  • Je werkt mee met de hand, maar ook met een schop of spade.
  • Je brengt de nodige materialen aan.
  • Je zorgt voor orde en properheid op de werf.

  • Je hebt ervaring als bouwarbeider, specifiek in de wegenwerken is een pluspunt.  
  • Je spreekt Nederlands en/of Engels.  
  • Je bezit een VCA-attest of bent bereid om deze te behalen.  
  • Je bent fysiek sterk en een doener.  
  • Je bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs B, BE is een pluspunt.  
  • Je bent in staat om zelfstandig en in teamverband te werken.

jobs.title: Grondwerker
jobs.description:
• Het aanleggen en herstellen van asfaltwegen, parkeerterreinen, en andere asfaltoppervlakken.
  • Het voorbereiden en bewerken van de werkplaats (o.a. het mengen en aanbrengen van asfalt).
  • Assisteren bij het instellen van machines en het bewaken van de kwaliteit van het werk.
  • Zorgen voor een veilige werkomgeving door het naleven van de veiligheidsvoorschriften.
  • Het uitvoeren van onderhouds- en herstelwerkzaamheden aan bestaande asfaltoppervlakken.

jobs.title: Operatieassistent
jobs.description:
Heb jij het in je? Als operatieassistent voel je je verantwoordelijk om alles rondom de ingreep nauwkeurig te regelen. De chirurg kan in de operatiekamer volledig op jouw kennis en kunde vertrouwen. Jij denkt altijd een stap vooruit. En omdat zaken regelmatig anders lopen dan gepland en je werkt in wisselende teams, weet jij je makkelijk aan de nieuwe situatie aan te passen. Voor jou is het heel normaal om collega's en patiënten op een duidelijke en prettige manier te woord te staan. Hierin beheers je de Nederlandse taal voldoende. Verder ben je:

- In het bezit van het diploma Operatieassistent of je rondt de opleiding binnenkort af.
- Een teamspeler, want: elke operatie is een teamprestatie.

Functie inhoud:

Vraag aan een operatieassistent in het Erasmus MC wat het werk zo interessant maakt en de woorden unieke en complexe operaties, een veelvoud aan specialismen, ruimte voor eigen ontwikkeling en werken in het leukste team van Rotterdam worden genoemd.

Je denkt nu misschien 'hoe zie ik dat dan terug in mijn werk?' Daar kom je maar op één manier achter: door een dag mee te lopen en het zelf te ervaren! Want dit is haast niet in woorden uit te drukken. We proberen het toch:

- Je assisteert bij levensreddende ingrepen van zware traumapatiënten die uit de hele regio in het Erasmus MC worden binnengebracht. Maar ook orgaantransplantaties, hartoperaties, kinderhartchirurgie en oncologische chirurgie vinden hier plaats.
- Innovatie staat bij ons voorop. Nieuwe operaties vinden vaak als eerste in het Erasmus MC plaats.
- Bij ons raak je nooit uitgeleerd. Wil je je op termijn verdiepen in je vak? Dat kan! Wij hebben zoveel specialismen in huis. Verdiep je bijvoorbeeld in neurochirurgie en wordt vakspecialist op dit gebied. En in klinische lessen hoor en leer je alles over de laatste technieken en nieuwste instrumenten.
- Je wordt goed begeleid en ingewerkt. Zo krijg je alle tijd en ruimte om onze OK, de ingrepen en de werkwijze te ontdekken.

Of je als operatieassistent op onze algemene OK wilt starten of nu al specifieke interesse hebt in bijvoorbeeld de unit Cardiothoracale Chirurgie, het Dagbehandelcentrum of het Erasmus MC Sophia Kinderziekenhuis... Samen met jou gaan we op zoek naar de beste plek.

Werkomgeving:

Jouw werkplek? De afdeling Operatiekamers. Dit is het OK-complex van het Erasmus MC, de Centrale Sterilisatie Afdeling (CSA) en Erasmus MC Sophia Kinderziekenhuis. De afdeling heeft in totaal 39 operatiekamers. Het complex is modern en hightech. Er is zelfs een Albert Heijn To Go met 24 uur per dag verse producten en versgemalen koffie. Hoe bijzonder is dat!

Wij zijn LAARMANN Group, een Nederlandse fabrikant van laboratorium en industriële monstervoorbereidingsapparatuur uit Roermond. Wij houden ons bezig met breken, malen, zeven en delen. In tegenstelling tot veel concurrenten zijn wij geen handelshuis: we ontwerpen en produceren zelf. Dat betekent dat jij als inkoper direct schakelt met engineering en productie, en je ziet het resultaat van je werk terug op de werkvloer.

Als Technisch Inkoper ben jij de spil tussen onze leveranciers en onze productie. Je koopt een breed pakket in: van machineonderdelen en machinecomponenten tot grondstoffen en verbruiksmaterialen. Geen dag is hetzelfde. De ene keer onderhandel je over een contract met een Europese toeleverancier, de andere keer los je een leveringsprobleem op dat de productielijn dreigt stil te leggen.

Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden: Selecteren, beoordelen en onderhouden van leveranciersrelaties, van componentenleveranciers tot grondstofpartners. Onderhandelen over prijzen, levertijden en contractvoorwaarden. Coördineren van inkoop rondom manufacturing, logistiek en supply chain. Zorgen dat materialen en onderdelen op tijd en volgens specificatie binnenkomen. Werken met ons ERP systeem MKG voor het plaatsen, volgen en beheren van inkooporders. Volgen van marktontwikkelingen en nieuwe leveranciers om kosten te besparen en kwaliteit te verbeteren. Nauw samenwerken met engineering, productie en logistiek om technische eisen te vertalen naar inkoopstrategie.

Je komt terecht in een compact, hands-on team waar je snel verantwoordelijkheid krijgt en waar jouw beslissingen er echt toe doen. Als zelf fabricerend bedrijf in Roermond bouwen we mee aan de toekomst van laboratoriumtechnologie, en we investeren in de groei van onze mensen.

jobs.title: Programme Manager
jobs.description:
ResultsinHealth (RiH) is looking for an energetic Programme Manager to join our Procurement and Supply chain Management (PSM) team in Leiderdorp. We are recruiting a new colleague with a hands-on mentality who is driven, diplomatic, organized, enthusiastic, tenacious, positive and cheerful.

Responsibilities
- Manage the RiH PSM portfolios: Ensure implementation and follow-up of multiple concurrent country workplans and services,
- Provide administrative support for RiH Experts on contracting, invoicing, communication, travel bookings, visas, report editing, and completeness of deliverables,
- Participate in New Business activities, develop expressions of interest for funders,
- Support the development and rollout of new initiatives, including RiHRecruit.com,
- Coordinate recruitment, maintenance, and management of RiH pool of Experts,
- Regular communication with RiH experts and partners backstopping teams,
- Provide coordination and support on supply chain assignments and Global Fund technical areas when applicable (based on skills and interest),
- Assist with improvements to RiH work processes and tools, strategic initiatives,
- Represent RiH at conferences, meetings and trainings when appropriate,
- Coordinate the provision of materials for RiH communication and outreach,
- Coordinate organization and liaison for meetings or training with experts/clients and in-house capacity building

ResultsinHealth is an international development advisory firm located in The Netherlands.
RiH is dedicated to effective disease prevention and to improving access to health care. We strengthen health systems and monitor the progress of program implementation. Based on our work and recommendations, donor agencies and governments make evidence-based decisions on spending for medicines and health products and controlling risks in supply chains for optimized efficiency.

Our largest client is the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria (GF). Since 2003, RiH has been a trusted and respected partner in evaluating supply chains in countries that receive GF grants. We work in more than 50 countries worldwide with a large group of experts, mainly pharmacists and laboratory specialists.

RiH is a lean and flexible organization recognized for its responsiveness to specific needs while providing excellent and solutions-oriented services to its clients. Recently, we launched RiHRecruit.com; global recruitment services for challenging roles in public health.

Visit our website for more information about our company and the vacancy: www.resultsinhealth.org

About HCSS
The Hague Centre for Strategic Studies (HCSS) is a leading think tank that provides strategic support to public and private organisations. Our goal is to offer fact-based analysis of the challenges that our societies face to inform public discourse, public and private strategic decision-making and contribute to international and national security in accordance with liberal democratic values. We typically conduct our research at the intersection of scientific research and strategic policy for governments, international organisations, and NGOs. We also offer analytical support to inform private sector strategic planning processes. Our work is funded through contract research, through research grants and we also develop our own initiatives.
Our fact-based analysis is intended to generate strategy and policy-relevant insights that inform real world decisions. To further this cause, we conduct both basic and applied research, we host public and closed-door events, and we convene and engage with a wide range of stakeholders to further our own thinking and to stimulate debate on the pressing issues of our time. We are not linked to any political party nor beholden to any external corporate or national interests.
Within our research portfolio, we specifically look at topics such as international and national security, defence, strategy, social resilience, emerging technologies, climate security, economic security, raw materials, energy transition, cyber policy, organised crime, and the broader geopolitical and geo-economic context. We conduct our research based on deep domain expertise, data-driven research, and innovative analytical methods.

Core stiffness: Your foundation for good movement
08 Oct
Jan
The ability to move well begins with a well-functioning foundation: the back. The spine is the core from which many movements are performed. Although a flexible back seems attractive, that is only partially true.
The entire back does not need to be flexible to function optimally. The lower back should actually be relatively stiff, while the upper back should be mobile. Think of a slingshot. The stick must be sturdy to effectively transmit the force of the elastic. The lower back is that stick. A wobbly stick cannot transmit forces, just as you cannot push a limp fire hose forward.
We often try to keep the entire back supple and mobile. Back problems often arise because the body attempts to create stiffness somewhere in the back. If this occurs in a place that should actually be mobile, the entire structure can become disrupted, which can result in various movement-related complaints, including further up the body. A stable joint that remains stable ensures an optimal range of motion of the mobile joint connected to it. How do you achieve core stiffness?
The lower back must therefore be relatively stiff so that the upper back can be mobile. Stability can be achieved in various ways. You can create stability like a brick wall, where the bottom brick cannot simply be removed. However, gravity can create too much pressure, which can cause discomfort. It is better to obtain stability, and thus core stiffness, by keeping the 'tent lines' taut. jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Hi, we’re Bloom & Wild. Founded in 2013, our mission back then was to make sending and receiving flowers the joy that it should be, by harnessing technology, brand and letterbox delivery. Together, we’ve fulfilled over 20 million deliveries (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe.

We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination. 

⚙️Technology at Bloom & Wild

Our Technology team of over 60 people sits right at the heart of our business. We build and maintain the solutions that power e-commerce, production and fulfilment, enabling our brands to delight our customers every day.

The Product Engineering team consists of five cross-functional squads who each lead their own business and architectural domain, and are supported by our Platform, Domain Engineering, Data and IT teams.

Our platform uses technologies including Ruby and Rails and Python/ React, backed by PostgreSQL, Fargate/ECS on AWS, and Cloud Run on GCP. It exposes APIs that are used by our multi-brand Angular webapp and our native iOS and Android mobile apps.  We’re also looking at developing new domain driven services & microservices where applicable.

Most of our team is based in the UK or The Netherlands and works in a flexible model, with choice in how often they travel to the office. Our squads meet in person at least once per quarter in order to maintain connections, collaborate on larger projects and have fun together.

You can read lots more about our technology stack and our culture over on our tech blog - Code & Wild


💻 What you’ll be doing

As a Platform Engineer you'll work across the whole of Technology (Frontend, Backend, Data Engineering, Data Science and Warehouse Tech) helping other engineers ship better, faster, and more safely. You'll split your time roughly equally between embedded engagements inside domain squads and central platform work on the shared infrastructure.

The role of an engineer is changing. AI has removed writing code as the scarce skill; the valuable engineer is the one who picks the right problems, scopes them, and owns them through to how they behave in production. This role leans into that shift. You will work with a high degree of independence and the work isn't always handed to you as ready-made tickets, so you'll have space to identify, shape and deliver on solutions end-to-end.

This includes:

  • Embedded Engagements: Partner with domain squads, shipping code and tools to directly enhance their capability and solve real problems.

  • Paved Roads: Build shared, adoption-driven infrastructure like feature flags, canary rollouts, fast builds, and CI/CD patterns. Making the easiest path the best path.

  • AI Integration: Extend AI across the engineering lifecycle (ticket generation, config authoring, incident response, code review), operating with AI as your core working mode and creating reusable patterns.

  • Core Infrastructure: Maintain and evolve shared services: AWS, GitHub, Datadog, Cloudflare, distributing ownership across the Platform team.

  • Eliminate Toil: Automate manual processes and remove friction from the developer day-to-day.

  • Enable Ownership: Coach squads on SLOs, observability, and AI tooling, ensuring they are capable of leading their production behaviour without relying on Platform.

  • Strategic Impact: Proactively identify, scope, and deliver high-leverage problems from month six onwards.


    • ✅ You’ll love this role if you…
  • Have day-to-day experience with AWS and Terraform, and the judgement to balance performance, cost, and reliability.
  • Our stack includes ECS Fargate, RDS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, Lambda, and EventBridge.
  • Have good judgement across CI/CD and observability, comfortable with safe and reliable deployment practices (we use GitHub Actions and Terraform Cloud), and comfortable using metrics, logs, and traces to understand how applications and infrastructure behave.
  • Experience and enthusiasm using AI coding tools, or a keenness to adopt this style of working.
  • Are willing to pick up app-side stacks like Ruby and Python, and are comfortable operating inside long-lived monoliths without trying to rewrite them.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of problems (even without a ticket) you're comfortable operating in ambiguity and defining the problem before the solution.
  • A curious and innovative mindset, open to feedback and coaching, and seek out opportunities for learning and development.
  • Driven to deliver high-quality results and take initiative.
  • You love to collaborate, and are at your best when working cross-functionally with other teams.
  • You're excited about problem-solving and love to take a logical and collaborative approach to finding solutions.

    •  

    It would be great if you also have...

  • Been part of rolling out production-ownership practices across a team or organisation.

  • Experience working on an e-commerce site or in a fast-growing (preferably consumer-facing) environment.

  • Experience setting patterns that other engineers adopted without being told to.

  • Experience writing services or apps that fit into distributed architectures — working with APIs, event-driven patterns, and the contracts and practices that keep distributed systems stable.

    • You can be based in the UK, the Netherlands or elsewhere. We're flexible on what this looks like and would love to discuss how you like to work!
     
    These are some of the skills and experience we think will enable success in this role, but please don’t worry if you are missing some of these. We’re committed to building a team made up of different strengths, skills and experiences, so if you’re excited about our values, passionate about what you do and would like to join us in doing things more thoughtfully, we’d love to hear from you.

    🌟 (some of) The good stuff

    To care wildly for our customers, firstly we care wildly for our teams. We work hard to craft a culture of thoughtfulness and care, where there is a strong sense of inclusion and belonging, enabling all of our people to thrive and be successful each day.

     

    🌻 Work that works for you 

    • Flexible working : our core hours are 10-4, but outside of these hours you can start or finish your day when works best for you

    • Work Abroad for up to 45 days each year 

    • Share in our success with a choice to take equity options

    • Enhanced family leave policy and a workplace nursery scheme

    • 1 day per year to volunteer on a project that’s close to your heart

     

    🌴 Time off

    • 25 days’ holiday + your birthday and bank holidays each year

    • Flexible bank holidays - trade a bank holiday for another day that fits your beliefs, values and celebration calendar

    • Option to buy an extra 5 days’ holiday each year 

     

    🌱 Health and wellbeing

    • Health cash plan through Simplyhealth

    • Mental health support through Open Up, including access to online therapy sessions

    • Allies and champions groups

    • Mental Health First Aiders and awareness training for our managers

    • Electric car scheme

    • Cycle to work scheme

    • Our office kitchen is stocked with drinks and snacks to keep you going

    • Financial wellbeing support through Bippit

     

    🌳 Growth & Development

    • A flexible training framework for every stage of your career development through our Bloom & Learn programme

    • Mentee and mentor opportunities with our external partners, such as The Women's Association and Mentoring for Growth run by Future Founders

    • Internal & external Speaker Sessions on a variety of different inspirational topics 

     

    💐 Moments that matter

    • Social & wellbeing monthly calendar

    • Summer and End of Year events, team lunches and post-peak celebrations

    • Irresistible discounts on our products, blooms & subscriptions!

     

    🏡 Belonging at Bloom & Wild

    We know that we learn through our differences, and building a diverse team has always been central to creating the best experience for our customers.  We value all backgrounds, perspectives, ideas and experiences, and encourage everyone to share their opinions openly within our caring and inclusive team.  Our champions community actively advances our culture of inclusion and belonging, which is organised around 8 pillars of diversity. These cross-business networks offer additional opportunities for connection, education, support and celebration, and ensure that inclusivity continues to be embedded in our ways of working.  



    🫱‍🫲 Getting hired

    We’ll do everything we can to make sure your interview experience with us is a good one. It’s a 2-way process, and we’re keen to answer all of the questions you may have, so that you can be sure (and excited!) that we’ll be the right place for you.  

     

    - Apply below (it takes 2 minutes!)

    - Chat with Chloe, our Talent Manager - to discuss our role and learn a bit more about you and how we might match your career & development goals.

    - Interview with some of our Platform team to get into more of the detail.

    - Show us how you work through a technical challenge, which can be a live paired whiteboard session.

    - Final chat with Steve, from our Tech leadership team.

     

    We believe in leading change for good, so if there’s anything that we can do to help throughout your application process, or if you have any feedback, please share this with us anonymously here so we can use this to improve your experience.

You’ll work closely with our Content Creator, Design team, Commercial team and wider Marketing team to get campaigns live quickly, optimise performance, and unlock new areas of growth.

Paid media is the heart of this role, but you'll also own key parts of the user journey, including writing, building, and launching campaign landing pages using our web tools to ensure end-to-end performance. Over time, there may also be the opportunity to support organic social planning, scheduling, and reporting alongside our Content Creator.

This would suit someone with strong hands-on performance marketing experience, ideally from an agency or fast-paced digital environment, who is ready to step into an in-house role with more ownership, more visibility, and more chance to shape what happens next.

 


What you'll do

🚀 Own our paid digital channels: Build, manage and optimise campaigns across paid search, paid social and programmatic display, helping us reach more people ready to make the switch to electric.

 

🔍 Get properly stuck into the detail: Dive into search query reports, audiences, bids, budgets and campaign performance to spot what’s working, what’s wasting spend, and where the next opportunity is.

 

🔧 Keep the digital engine humming: Work hands-on across SA360, DV360, Campaign Manager and Meta Ads Manager, making sure campaigns are set up cleanly, tracking works, audiences flow through, and everything goes live without drama.

 

📈 Spend smartly: Help manage digital spend within agreed monthly targets, reporting regularly on pacing, CPL and performance, with clear recommendations on where to push, pause or test next.

 

🧪 Test, learn, repeat: Partner with our Content Creator and Design team to test new creative hooks, formats, audiences and messaging across paid search, paid social and programmatic.

📊 Make reporting actually useful: Turn channel data into clear, practical insight, helping the B2C squad understand what’s happening, why, and what we should do next.

🌐 Own landing page launches & web optimisations: Take end-to-end ownership when campaigns require new landing pages and other pieces of content like quizzes, drafting page copy (with support from the team), building them using our CMS/web tools, and setting them live.

🤝 Make things happen: Coordinate briefs, assets, links, tracking and launches across content, design, web and wider marketing teams so campaigns get live quickly and with as little faff as possible. You’ll also be happy jumping into wider growth priorities when the team needs it.


What you'll need

  • Strong experience of hands-on performance marketing experience, ideally in a fast-paced agency, media, content or high-growth in-house environment. We’re open on exact years of experience - what matters most is your technical ability, curiosity and attitude.

  • Strong paid search experience, with the confidence to build, manage and optimise campaigns day to day, including search query analysis, bid optimisation, budget pacing and performance reporting.

  • A proper performance mindset. You enjoy digging into the numbers, finding wasted spend, spotting growth opportunities and working out what we should do next.

jobs.title: Senior Regional Marketing Manager - EMEA West
jobs.description:
You must be located in Europe to be considered for this position and are available for occasional travel to our Munich, Germany office.

Tulip brings modern technology and AI into manufacturing. Manufacturing accounts for almost 20% of the global economy and one in every seven workers on Earth, yet remains among the least digitized. More than a decade ago, we created the category to close that gap: AI-native software that puts cutting-edge tools directly in the hands of the people on the manufacturing front lines. Because we are human-centered and tech-obsessed, we are building a future of work where human ingenuity is amplified with the latest technology.

In January 2026 we became one of Boston's few new AI unicorns, reaching a $1.3B valuation. We're growing double digits in revenue year over year. The world's best manufacturers run on Tulip - turning inventory 10x faster, releasing gene therapies in hours instead of weeks, and training master craftspeople to forge engagement rings 5x more rapidly. Headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, Japan, and Israel, we've been consistently named a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a Gartner leader, and one of Built In Boston's "Best Places to Work."

We run the way we build: AI-forward, humanistic, and high ownership. We're looking for builders who are energized by complex problems, rapid cycles, and the unique opportunity to see their impact on a global scale.

About the Role:

Tulip is expanding fast across international markets, and this role sits at the center of that growth. You build demand in regions where we are still establishing the brand, with real room to shape how Tulip shows up and wins. This is full ownership of the marketing plan for your region, not a slice of the funnel.

You own or co-manage one or more regions: the account programs, the field events, and the pipeline that comes from them. You are the lynchpin between your region and the commercial organization, working alongside sales, BDRs, and partners to build go-to-market motions that convert target accounts. You continuously iterate on which programs and accounts work, optimize spend across your region, and own the plan from strategy to execution without waiting on a hand-off. You have a high ceiling, are full of ideas, analytically rigorous, and wired to see your work drive real outcomes. You are motivated to both sell and build with AI, and here you use it to produce, test, and iterate faster than a traditional team can.

What skills do I need?

  • 8-10+ years of experience in go-to-market, regional marketing, or partner marketing, with a record of owning outcomes rather than completing tasks.
  • Experience running account- and journey-based programs against a defined target account list, from campaign build to pipeline attribution.
  • Track record collaborating with BDRs, AEs, and partners on target accounts through structured programs: joint account planning, account prioritization, and coordinated outreach against a shared pipeline target.
  • Regional market fluency: adapting messaging and programs to local buying behavior, language, and market norms.
  • Analytical rigor: you understand pipeline math, read a campaign performance report, and tell signal from noise.
  • Low ego, high accountability: you would rather learn what works than be right.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own and carry pipeline targets for one or more regions.
  • Build and own the regional marketing plan and account segmentation across core and ABM channels.
  • Understand regional industries and target personas, then define content needs and formats and drive production and localization.
  • Build and run account-based programs against target accounts, coordinating campaigns and outreach with BDRs and AEs.
  • Run or support conferences and regional field events from planning through pipeline attribution.
  • Use AI to produce, test, and iterate on assets and campaigns at higher volume.

Key Collaborators:

  • Regional Sales leadership
  • BDRs and Account Executives
  • RevOps
  • Digital Marketing
  • AI go-to-market engineer
  • Product Marketing

Working At Tulip

We know even great candidates experience imposter syndrome. Even if you don't match every requirement, applying gives you the opportunity to be considered. We're building a strong, diverse team that values hard work, families, and personal well-being. Benefits of working with us include:

  • Direct impact on product and culture
  • Company equity
  • Competitive benefits package including commuter benefits, learning and development stipend, team events, catered lunches 3 days a week
  • Flexible work schedule and unlimited vacation policy
  • An inclusive, dog-friendly office with diverse and inspiring colleagues

We are an equal opportunity employer. At Tulip, we celebrate all. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
